messages:
Neil: heads-up — eu-west2 is seeing a slow drift in GPU attach success rate since 05:40, attach latency up ~6x. root cause looks storage-related.
Rina: which metric is spiking? iops, latencies, or errors?
Neil: nvme_iops near-saturation on a subset of nodes + increases in nvme controller error counts. sample from gnode-eu-07-04: 
```
[ 5123.123456] nvme0: controller error status; ps 0x1
[ 5123.124000] nvme0n1: metadata checksum mismatch, nsid 1
[ 5124.500000] scrubber: scheduling deep-scrub for extent 0xdeadbeef
```
Omar: any recent cluster jobs that could overlap? janitor/tempfile sweeps or a scrub rollout?
Neil: yes — last night we increased tempfile-sweep concurrency in eu-west2 and a scrub scheduler tweak rolled at 02:15. looks like they are colliding on the same hosts.
Rina: short-term mitigation: 1) scale back scrub concurrency to 1 for impacted nodes, 2) pause tempfile sweep CronJob in eu-west2 for 20m, 3) prefer other regions for non-pinned attaches for 30m.
Omar: agree. I'll push the commands and set a transient routing override.
Omar: ```
kubectl -n storage set env daemonset/scrubber SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=1 --context=prod-eu-west2
kubectl -n janitor patch cronjob/tempfile-sweep -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}' --context=prod-eu-west2
# set routing override for 30m
redwoodctl routing set-preference --from eu-west2 --to eu-west1 --duration 30m
```
ops-bot: scrubber concurrency reduced; tempfile-sweep suspended; routing override active.
Neil: immediate effect: attach pending queue from ~110 -> ~30 in ~2m, iowait trending down. good signal.
Rina: follow-ups: run nondestructive nvme-verify on flagged hosts, open vendor firmware check for matching controller serials, and add controller-level guard to avoid concurrent deep-scrub + janitor on same node.
Omar: I'll draft the small RB to gate scrub by node iowait and add a controller flag. tagging infra-oncall to own host replacements if verify shows progressive media errors.
infra-oncall: acknowledged. monitoring dashboards and will update if any host retirement is needed.
Neil: thanks — will keep thread updated with verify results. :thumbsup:
